decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal is considered acceptable as no external works are proposed; taking into account the small area of ground floor space that would be used as a telecommunications switch room, with the use of the first floor of the units having previously been granted planning permission as a telecommunications switch room (in April 2003 under reference 01483/B/P1); and because there would be no change in the number employed.  In this case and because the proposal would not lead to a scarcity of land or buildings for B1/B2/B8 use it meets Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses), E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria), T.1.2  (The Movement Implications of Development), T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), E.3.1 (Disabled Access), E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use) and ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (UDP), Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for a telecommunication switch room and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE:  Planning permission 01483/B/P1 was granted on 8 April 2003 for the change of use of the first floor of the units as a telecoms switching centre with a diesel generator at ground floor level.  It required full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound to be submitted to and approved by the Council as Local Planning Authority before the change of was begun.  Development has not been carried out in accordance with planning permission 01483/B/P1 because full particulars and details were not submitted to and approved by the Council prior to the change of use.  They should, therefore, be submitted as soon as possible.  You are advised that if no action is taken the Council will consider the expediency of taking enforcement action.
description: Change of use of ground floor from storage/warehouse to telecommunication switch room.
